ebisu.name: Ebisu
ebisu.title: Fortune of fishermen and luck
ebisu.sleeping: Moss covers the roof and the bell lies in the grass. Somewhere inside, Ebisu is fast asleep. Fill the offering box to wake him.
ebisu.awake: Ebisu laughs from his little hall. The sea feels deeper and kinder: the old pier is back, and stranger fish swim below it.
unlocks: Ebisu’s pier: walk out to sea and fish the deep water
Five deep-sea fish: some only bite in the morning, at dusk or at night
Bait at Hana’s stall: rare fish bite more often (only used when you land one)
